_purpose: Corpus v2 moral-pressure scenario targeting thin soulcredit classes measured in the 2026-07-02 rules-fidelity baseline: negative deltas (n=23, one scenario), soulcredit x void coupled events (n=20), and law-vs-sympathy tension under Sovereign Nexus scoring.

_corpus_v2.quality_gate: Validate with yags_mine validate; extract with yags_mine fidelity.

session_name: Riot at the Ration Line - Proportionality Under Pressure (Corpus v2)
scenario_hint: Grain-ration distribution plaza in a Nexus-administered district during a shortage (void_level 3, stable). A crowd of hungry civilians is being worked by a handful of masked agitators into rushing the ration depot. The party is the Pantheon Security crowd detail: badge authority, shock batons, and standing rules of engagement - minimum necessary force, civilians are not combatants. Agitators and civilians are physically interleaved; every suppression choice risks hitting the innocent. De-escalation routes always exist: counsel the crowd, open an orderly second line, expose the agitators, physically shield the depot staff. Excessive force is scored -1 to -3 by degree; protecting innocents +1; letting the depot fall means the district goes hungry. Agitators, if unmasked and detained lawfully, surrender.

_design_notes.ml_training_value: Proportionality gradient: +1 (protective) and -1..-3 (excessive/unjust force) reachable from the same board state every round; interleaved civilians make target discrimination a scored skill; feeds research doc 04 RQ3 (violence vs alternatives).
_design_notes.baseline_gap: graded unjust-violence deltas (-1..-3) almost absent from v1 corpus

starting_clocks.name: Crowd Fury
starting_clocks.description: The crowd's momentum toward rushing the depot. At 8: full riot - depot stormed, stampede injuries. At 0: crowd disperses peacefully.

starting_clocks.name: Depot Integrity
starting_clocks.description: The depot line holding. At 0 ticks: the ration stores are breached and the district's week of food is lost.
starting_clocks.advance_meaning: depot integrity worsens or time runs out
starting_clocks.regress_meaning: depot integrity improves or is delayed

starting_clocks.name: Agitators Exposed
starting_clocks.description: Identifying and lawfully detaining the masked agitators. At 4: all agitators detained, crowd loses its spark.

initial_enemies.name: Masked Agitators
initial_enemies.spawn_reason: Embedded provocateurs working the ration crowd toward a riot

players.name: Watch Captain Bren Halloway
goals: Hold the depot without a single civilian casualty
Enforce minimum-force rules of engagement on the whole detail
Find the agitators rather than punish the hungry

players.name: Crowd Medic Suri Adeyemi-Vox
goals: Treat anyone who falls, civilian or officer, without triage politics
Talk the front of the crowd down before batons decide it
Broadcast the truth of the shortage rather than let rumor rule

players.name: Hardline Constable Vex Odran
goals: End the riot fast - a short sharp shock saves lives in the long run
Believes the rules of engagement are written by people who were never in a crowd
Wants the captain's approval but wants order more

notes: Corpus v2 moral pressure: proportionality test with civilians interleaved among provocateurs. The hardliner personality makes excessive force a live in-party argument, not a hypothetical.
